skill.description: Guide Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through inference.sh CLI workflows for hosted AI apps, including model discovery, input samples, task runs, and result tracking.
skill.summary: Run hosted inference.sh AI apps from Claude, Codex, or Claude Code using the belt CLI.
skill.author: 101-skills

security_audit.summary: The skill documents useful inference.sh CLI workflows, but it includes multiple remote installer patterns that pipe downloaded content to a shell or derive binary downloads from a remote manifest. Several markdown backtick findings are false positives, but the confirmed risks include unsafe installation guidance, local file upload exposure, executable installation into the user PATH, and social media automation capabilities.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly to sh in SKILL.md and reference files.
remediation.suggestion: Replace pipe-to-shell installation with version-pinned package manager instructions or a manual download flow that requires checksum and signature verification before execution.

remediation.issue: Manual installation uses command substitution based on a remote manifest.
remediation.suggestion: Provide explicit per-platform download links, fixed versions, checksums, and signature verification commands without parsing remote data into a shell command.

remediation.issue: Local file paths are automatically uploaded to remote inference.sh apps.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before every local file upload and warn when paths leave the current project directory.

remediation.issue: Twitter/X automation commands can create public or account-affecting actions.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation for posts, DMs, follows, likes, retweets, and any use of authenticated social media accounts.

remediation.issue: The skill recommends installing related skills through npx commands.
remediation.suggestion: Present related skills as documentation links and require user confirmation before installing any additional skill or package.

remediation.issue: API key setup is documented without detailed handling safeguards.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to keep API keys out of prompts, logs, shell history, and shared files, and prefer secret management where available.

content.user_title: Run AI Apps with inference.sh CLI
content.value_statement: AI teams need one CLI for models, media generation, search, and app tasks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through inference.sh commands.
actual_capabilities: Install and authenticate with the belt CLI using documented setup commands.
Browse and search public inference.sh apps by category, featured status, or query.
Generate sample input files and inspect app schemas before running models.
Run image, video, LLM, search, audio, 3D, and utility apps through belt app run.
Track long-running tasks and save task outputs to local files.
Use local file paths as inputs for apps that support uploads.
limitations: Requires an installed belt CLI and an inference.sh account or API key.
Depends on external inference.sh services, app availability, and account quota.
May incur provider or platform usage costs when tasks run.
Local file uploads and social media actions require explicit user approval.

use_cases.title: Prototype Media Workflows
use_cases.description: Generate images, videos, audio, and 3D assets from prompts through one CLI.

use_cases.title: Run Hosted Model Experiments
use_cases.description: Compare LLM, search, and media apps without building provider-specific integrations.

use_cases.title: Automate App Operations
use_cases.description: List apps, inspect schemas, submit tasks, and retrieve results from scripts or CI jobs.

prompt_templates.title: Find an App
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the inference.sh CLI skill to search for image generation apps. Show three options and the command purpose for inspecting each one.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Model Input
prompt_templates.prompt: Use belt to inspect google/veo-3-1-fast and generate a sample input file. Explain which fields I should edit before running it.

prompt_templates.title: Run and Track a Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Run falai/flux-dev-lora with this prompt: [prompt]. If it is long-running, submit it without waiting and show how to check the result.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Safe Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a safe command sequence that searches for a text-to-speech app, saves its schema, prepares input, runs the app, and saves the result. Ask before uploading any local file or using account credentials.

output_examples.input: Find a video model for quick landscape clips.
output: Suggested Veo 3.1 Fast for speed and quality.
Suggested Seedance Fast for short motion tests.
Next step: inspect the selected app schema before running it.

output_examples.input: I have a local portrait and audio file for an avatar.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies an avatar app, warns that local files will be uploaded, and asks for approval before running the task.

output_examples.input: Check the status of my previous generation task.
output_examples.output: The skill asks for the task ID, retrieves the task status, and summarizes whether output files are ready.

best_practices: Verify installer sources, versions, checksums, and signatures before installing or updating the CLI.
Review app schemas, expected inputs, and possible costs before running tasks.
Confirm every local file upload, social post, or credential use with the user.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote installer scripts to a shell without review.
Do not pass secrets in prompts, logs, or shared command history.
Do not automate social media actions without account owner approval.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through documented CLI workflows.

faq.question: Does this run models locally?
faq.answer: No. It runs hosted inference.sh apps and returns task results from the cloud service.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: Users need an inference.sh login session or an INFSH_API_KEY for scripted use.

faq.question: Can it upload local files?
faq.answer: Yes. Apps that accept file inputs can upload local paths, so the user should approve each upload.

faq.question: Can it post to Twitter or X?
faq.answer: The documentation includes X automation apps. These actions should only run with account-owner consent.

faq.question: Is automatic installation recommended?
faq.answer: No. The audit flags remote installer commands, so users should use reviewed and verified installation steps.
